auditor.dependency_scope: Python standard library; no SocioLab imports

documented_measurement.dataset_page_scope: Voluntary conference badge wearers, about 110 attendees over about 2.5 days; no personal data or Live Social Semantics metadata are published here.
documented_measurement.license_statement: The official dataset page links Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported and requests the paper citation and SocioPatterns acknowledgement.
documented_measurement.origin_local_description: Official page says 08:00 on 29 June 2009; this matches Europe/Rome summer time, not 08:00 UTC.
documented_measurement.paper_abstract_pdf_page_2: The authors report that static aggregated networks can yield erroneous transmission-path conclusions compared with time-resolved data.
documented_measurement.paper_section_III_pdf_pages_3_to_4: Daily static graphs link two tags when at least one contact is detected; weights aggregate contact duration.
documented_measurement.paper_section_II_pdf_page_3: Badges exchange short-range radio packets; a contact is maintained by packet exchange within successive 20-second bins. About 75% of HT09 participants volunteered; the authors explicitly discuss possible volunteer-selection bias and incomplete sampling.
documented_measurement.tsv_semantics: t i j records an undirected proximity observation in the source-described interval [t-20,t]; timestamps are seconds relative to Unix origin 1246255200.

json_format_diagnostic.candidate_expansion: range(start,end,20) interpreted as candidate TSV endpoint labels, solely to compare source encodings
json_format_diagnostic.decision: Use the unchanged official TSV and its explicit interval definition for analysis. Preserve the JSON discrepancy; do not silently correct it or claim exact agreement of the raw encodings.

primary_references.dataset_citation: Isella et al. (2011), What's in a crowd? Analysis of face-to-face behavioral networks, Journal of Theoretical Biology 271, 166-180.

scope_and_qualification.actor_universe_basis: Retrospective union of all anonymous endpoint IDs in the TSV archive; not an independently verified conference roster.
limits: No independent badge uptime, attendance, or exposure ledger is supplied by these two published files.
A time window inside the first/last recorded ticks does not establish continuous observation coverage.
A node with no record in a window remains in the fixed archive universe as zero recorded degree, with physical state unknown.
Twenty times the pair-bin count is recorded pair-bin seconds, not an exact measurement of continuous interaction seconds or distinct encounters.
Static connected paths do not establish time-respecting or realized information/disease transmission.
scope_and_qualification.source_log_completeness_qualification: Not independently established by the published files; parsing every supplied row is a separate check.
scope_and_qualification.zero_edge_meaning: No qualifying record in the selected published-file window, not confirmed absence of physical proximity or a social relationship.
